findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant isolation for document reads
findings.body: When a user and document belong to different tenants, `canReadDocument` now returns `true` unconditionally. Any caller relying on this authorization boundary can therefore expose documents across tenants; retain the tenant equality check or an equivalent authorization rule.

findings.title: [P1] Reject reads across tenant boundaries
findings.body:
`canReadDocument` now authorizes every request. Whenever `userTenant !== documentTenant`, callers relying on this access check will permit unauthorized cross-tenant document reads and potential data disclosure.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant isolation in the document read check
findings.body:
`canReadDocument` now authorizes every request. Any caller supplying distinct `userTenant` and `documentTenant` values will permit a cross-tenant document read, bypassing the function’s authorization boundary.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._
